info.title: VeilNet Guardian
info.description: VeilNet Guardian is a microservice that serves as the central management service for VeilNet infrastructure. It provides REST APIs for managing Veil servers, realms (planes), confluxes (client connections), user authentication, organization and team management, and subscription handling. The Guardian microservice coordinates between Veil servers via NATS messaging and manages IP address allocation, certificate generation, and access control.

post.description:
Create a new realm.

Validates user permissions (superuser for public realms, subscription
required for private realms) and creates a new realm with the specified
configuration.

Args:
    request: Request containing realm configuration
    user: Authenticated user from dependency injection

Returns:
    PublicRealms: Created realm object

Raises:
    HTTPException: If user lacks permissions (403), veil not found (400),
        subscription invalid (403), or creation fails (500)

get.description:
Get a specific realm by ID.

Verifies user has access to the realm before returning it.

Args:
    realm_id: ID of the realm to retrieve
    user: Authenticated user from dependency injection

Returns:
    PublicRealmDetails: Realm object

Raises:
    HTTPException: If realm not found or access denied (404/403)
        or server error (500)

delete.description:
Delete a realm.

Only the realm owner can delete a realm.

Args:
    realm_id: ID of the realm to delete
    user: Authenticated user from dependency injection

Returns:
    PublicRealmDetails: Deleted realm object

Raises:
    HTTPException: If realm not found or user not owner (404/403)
        or deletion fails (500)

get.description:
List all realms accessible to the user.

Returns realms owned by the user, public realms, and realms
associated with teams the user is a member of.

Args:
    user: Authenticated user from dependency injection

Returns:
    List[PublicRealmDetails]: List of accessible realms

Raises:
    HTTPException: If listing fails (500)

schema.title: Response Handle List Realms Realm List Get

patch.description:

delete.description:

Only the realm owner can remove the subscription.

Args:

    user: Authenticated user from dependency injection

Returns:
    JSONResponse: Success message

Raises:

delete.description:

get.description:

post.description:
Create a new conflux for a realm.

Creates a conflux with certificates and generates an authentication
token. Verifies user has access to the realm.

Args:
    request: Request containing realm_id and optional tag
    user: Authenticated user from dependency injection

Returns:
    JSONResponse: Conflux token and ID

Raises:
    HTTPException: If CA certs not found (500) or creation fails (500)

get.description:
Get a specific conflux by ID.

Verifies user has access to the conflux before returning it.

Args:
    conflux_id: ID of the conflux to retrieve
    user: Authenticated user from dependency injection

Returns:
    PublicConfluxDetails: Conflux object

Raises:
    HTTPException: If conflux not found (404), access denied (403),
        or retrieval fails (500)

delete.description:
Delete a conflux.

Verifies user has access to the conflux before deletion.

Args:
    conflux_id: ID of the conflux to delete
    user: Authenticated user from dependency injection

Returns:
    PublicConfluxDetails: Deleted conflux object

Raises:
    HTTPException: If conflux not found (404), access denied (403),
        or deletion fails (500)

post.description:
Register a conflux using a registration token.

Creates a new conflux or returns an existing one if CIDR matches.
Associates teams if specified. Requires a valid registration token.

Args:
    credentials: HTTP bearer token containing registration token
    request: Request containing optional tag, CIDR, and teams

Returns:
    JSONResponse: Conflux token and ID

Raises:
    HTTPException: If token invalid (401), CIDR invalid (400),
        IP not available (400), CA certs not found (500),
        or registration fails (500)

delete.description:
Unregister a conflux.

Deletes a conflux that was registered with a registration token.
Requires a valid registration token.

Args:
    credentials: HTTP bearer token containing registration token
    conflux_id: ID of the conflux to unregister

Returns:
    JSONResponse: Success message

Raises:
    HTTPException: If token invalid (401) or unregistration fails (500)

post.description:
Login to a conflux session.

Creates or retrieves an IP lease, verifies access permissions,
and creates a conflux session. Updates conflux portal status.

Args:
    request: FastAPI request object for country code verification
    loginReq: Request containing signature and portal flag
    conflux: Authenticated conflux from dependency injection

Returns:
    PublicConfluxDetails: Updated conflux object

Raises:
    HTTPException: If access denied (403), no IPs available (500),
        or login fails (500)

Logout from a conflux session.

Deletes the conflux session. For non-portal confluxes, also
deletes the conflux itself.

Args:
    conflux: Authenticated conflux from dependency injection

Raises:
    HTTPException: If logout fails (500)

post.description:
Create a new Veil server.

Only superusers can create Veil servers. Generates certificates
for the Veil and stores the configuration.

Args:
    req: Request containing Veil configuration
    user: Authenticated user from dependency injection
    
Returns:
    PublicVeils: Created Veil object
    
Raises:
    HTTPException: If user is not superuser (403), CA certs not found (500),
        or creation fails (500)

get.description:
Get a specific Veil server by ID.

Returns the Veil if it's owned by the user or is public.

Args:
    veil_id: ID of the Veil to retrieve
    user: Authenticated user from dependency injection
    
Returns:
    PublicVeils: Veil object
    
Raises:
    HTTPException: If Veil not found (404) or retrieval fails (500)

delete.description:
Delete a Veil server.

Only superusers can delete Veil servers. Only the owner can
delete their own Veil.

Args:
    veil_id: ID of the Veil to delete
    user: Authenticated user from dependency injection
    
Returns:
    PublicVeils: Deleted Veil object
    
Raises:
    HTTPException: If user is not superuser (403), Veil not found (404),
        or deletion fails (500)

get.description:
List all Veil servers accessible to the user.

Returns Veils owned by the user and public Veils.

Args:

Returns:

Raises:
    HTTPException: If listing fails (500)

AddRealmMemberRequest.title: AddRealmMemberRequest
AddRealmMemberRequest.description:
Request model for adding a member to a realm.

Attributes:
    realm_id: ID of the realm to add member to
    user_id: ID of the user to add as member

ConfluxInfo.title: ConfluxInfo
ConfluxInfo.description:
Response model for conflux info.

Attributes:
    id: ID of the conflux
    tag: Tag of the conflux
    uid: UID of the conflux
    cidr: CIDR of the conflux
    rift: Whether the conflux is in rift mode
    portal: Whether the conflux is a portal conflux
    public: Whether the conflux is public

ConfluxSessionLoginRequest.title: ConfluxSessionLoginRequest
ConfluxSessionLoginRequest.description:
Request model for conflux session login.

Attributes:
    signature: Cryptographic signature for validation
    portal: Whether this is a portal conflux

CreateConfluxRequest.title: CreateConfluxRequest
CreateConfluxRequest.description:
Request model for creating a new conflux.

Attributes:
    realm_id: ID of the realm to create conflux for
    tag: Optional tag for categorizing the conflux

CreateIdentityRequest.title: CreateIdentityRequest
CreateIdentityRequest.description:
Request model for creating a new identity.

Attributes:
    audience: Audience of the identity
    issuer: Issuer of the identity
    jwks_url: JWKS URL of the identity

CreateRealmRequest.title: CreateRealmRequest
CreateRealmRequest.description:
Request model for creating a new realm.

Attributes:
    name: Name of the realm
    subnet: CIDR notation of the realm's subnet (must be private)
    public: Whether the realm is public
    veil_id: ID of the associated Veil server
    subscription_id: Optional subscription ID for private realms

CreateRegistrationTokenRequest.title: CreateRegistrationTokenRequest
CreateRegistrationTokenRequest.description:
Request model for creating a registration token.

Attributes:
    realm_id: ID of the realm to create token for
    expires_after: Number of days until token expiration
    tag: Optional tag for categorizing the token

CreateVeilRequest.title: CreateVeilRequest
CreateVeilRequest.description:
Request model for creating a new Veil server.

Attributes:
    name: Name of the Veil server
    region: Geographic region where the Veil is located
    host: IP address or hostname of the Veil
    port: Port number the Veil listens on
    public: Whether the Veil is publicly accessible (default: True)

RealmSubscribeRequest.title: RealmSubscribeRequest
RealmSubscribeRequest.description:
Request model for creating a realm subscription checkout session.

Attributes:
    success_url: URL to redirect to after successful payment
    cancel_url: URL to redirect to if payment is cancelled

RegisterConfluxRequest.title: RegisterConfluxRequest
RegisterConfluxRequest.description:
Request model for registering a conflux.

Attributes:
    tag: Optional tag for categorizing the conflux
    jwt: Optional JWT for authentication
    jwks_url: Optional JWKS URL for authentication
    audience: Optional audience for authentication
    issuer: Optional issuer for authentication

RemoveRealmMemberRequest.title: RemoveRealmMemberRequest
RemoveRealmMemberRequest.description:
Request model for removing a member from a realm.

Attributes:
    realm_id: ID of the realm to remove member from
    user_id: ID of the user to remove as member

UpdateDisplayNameRequest.title: UpdateDisplayNameRequest
UpdateDisplayNameRequest.description:
Request model for updating user display name.

Attributes:
    display_name: New display name for the user

UpdateRealmSubscriptionRequest.title: UpdateRealmSubscriptionRequest
UpdateRealmSubscriptionRequest.description:
Request model for updating realm subscription.

Attributes:
    realm_id: ID of the realm to update
    subscription_id: ID of the subscription to associate
